title: RouteData
summary: Derive data from a Preact loader or action type.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: For a function type, takes its awaited return type, excludes Response and Error, and unwraps DataResponse<T> to T. For a non-function type, uses that type unchanged.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: Use type-only handler imports in browser modules. A raw Response does not carry an inferable JSON payload type; return plain data or data(...) when inferred hook types are needed. This helper does not recursively Await nested fields.
